settings.title: Tell me more
settings.text: Most snacks packed for a day out are a compromise, given because there is nothing else to hand. Yummybara is made to be the snack you are glad to hand over. Each age gets a texture it can manage: melts that soften as soon as they touch saliva at 8 months+, baked rusks that hold their shape at 10 months+, and real crunch at 12 months+. Every snack is organic, halal certified, and made with no preservatives and no added refined sugar or salt. Each one comes in its own snack-sized pack, sealed one by one, so a few go in the bag for the zoo or a long car ride.

settings.title: What's inside
settings.text:
First Melts, 8 months+: yoghurt, cereal, coconut milk and cheese melts, plus freeze-dried rice rusks.

First Bites, 10 months+: baked rice rusks, plus the melts from First Melts.

Big Crunch, 12 months+: filled rice sticks, puff pops, DHA puff rice sticks, shrimp wafer crisps, dark chocolate melts, triangle corn puffs and freeze-dried fruit.

settings.question: My child is 9 months. Which bundle?
settings.answer: First Melts, 8 months+. Everything in it melts. Move up to First Bites when your child is holding food and gnawing on it, usually around 10 months. If you are between two ages, pick the younger one.

settings.question: My child is 11 months. First Bites or Big Crunch?
settings.answer: First Bites. Big Crunch has filled sticks and wafers that need proper chewing. Move up at 12 months, or later if your child is still working on chewing.

settings.question: Aren't baby snacks just carbs?
settings.answer: Some are. The rusks, rice sticks and puffs are rice snacks, and we say so. The melts are made with yoghurt, cheese or coconut milk, and the freeze-dried fruit is made from fruit. Every one is made with no added refined sugar or salt.

settings.question: Why not just bring fruit?
settings.answer: Fruit is a great snack. A sealed pack just needs less fuss on the go: no washing or cutting, and nothing bruises at the bottom of the bag.

settings.question: What if my child doesn't like a flavour?
settings.answer: Every bundle has at least 10 different snacks, so one miss still leaves plenty to try.

settings.question: Are the melts right for a baby who is just starting?
settings.answer: First Melts is made for 8 months+. The melts are freeze-dried, so they soften as soon as they touch saliva. As with any food, stay with your child while they eat.

settings.question: Is it organic and halal?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Yummybara snack is organic, halal certified, and made with no preservatives and no added refined sugar or salt.

settings.question: Does it contain allergens?
settings.answer: Yes, and every box lists them. The melts contain milk. The Jumbo Filled Rice Sticks contain wheat, milk and egg. The Shrimp Wafer Crisps contain crustaceans. Some products are made in a facility that also handles soybean, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and crustaceans. Check the box for your child's allergy before serving.

settings.question: How do I store it, and how long does it keep?
settings.answer: Cool, dry place, away from heat and sunlight. Unopened, the melts keep 18 months and most other products 12 months.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: Free on every bundle. We pack your order in 1 to 2 business days, and J&T delivers in another 1 to 2. Singapore only.

settings.question: Is a bundle cheaper than buying the boxes one by one?
settings.answer: Yes. About 10% less for Standard and about 15 to 17% less for the Value pack. The bought separately price sits beside every size.

settings.question: What is the free gift with the Value pack?
settings.answer: One pack of Habibara Pure & Gentle Baby Wet Wipes (80 sheets) and a 3-pack of Habibara Pure & Gentle Baby Wipes (25 sheets each), worth S$8.75. It comes in the same delivery.

settings.question: Can I choose my own boxes?
settings.answer: Not for now. The bundles are set for each age, so every box suits your child.
